desc:
Play rated chess games, challenge bots, solve puzzles, and sharpen your skills.

⚔️ Compete against real players in rated online matches
🤖 Challenge bots from beginner to master
🧩 Solve chess puzzles and improve your tactics
📊 Review your games and explore positions with the analysis board
📖 Discover openings as you play
🥇 Rank up from Bronze to Grand Master and climb the leaderboards

👶 New to chess? Start with a beginner bot and build your skills one move at a time!

👍 Like and ⭐ Favourite for future updates!
